structure RatNum where
  num : Int
  den : Nat
  den_pos : 0 < den

def ratnum_zero : RatNum := RatNum.mk 0 1 (Nat.zero_lt_succ 0)

def ratnum_one : RatNum := RatNum.mk 1 1 (Nat.zero_lt_succ 0)

def ratnum_neg_one : RatNum := RatNum.mk (-1) 1 (Nat.zero_lt_succ 0)

theorem ratnum_zero_den_pos : 0 < ratnum_zero.den :=
  Nat.zero_lt_succ 0

theorem ratnum_one_den_pos : 0 < ratnum_one.den :=
  Nat.zero_lt_succ 0

theorem ratnum_zero_num : ratnum_zero.num = 0 :=
  Eq.refl _

theorem ratnum_one_num : ratnum_one.num = 1 :=
  Eq.refl _

theorem ratnum_one_den : ratnum_one.den = 1 :=
  Eq.refl _

def ratnum_den_ne_zero (r : RatNum) : r.den ≠ 0 :=
  Nat.not_eq_zero_of_lt r.den_pos

def ratnum_add (a b : RatNum) : RatNum :=
  let n : Int := a.num * (b.den : Int) + b.num * (a.den : Int)
  let d : Nat := a.den * b.den
  let dp : 0 < d := Nat.mul_pos a.den_pos b.den_pos
  RatNum.mk n d dp

def ratnum_mul (a b : RatNum) : RatNum :=
  let n : Int := a.num * b.num
  let d : Nat := a.den * b.den
  let dp : 0 < d := Nat.mul_pos a.den_pos b.den_pos
  RatNum.mk n d dp

def ratnum_neg (a : RatNum) : RatNum :=
  RatNum.mk (-a.num) a.den a.den_pos

def ratnum_sub (a b : RatNum) : RatNum :=
  ratnum_add a (ratnum_neg b)

def ratnum_inv (a : RatNum) (h : a.num ≠ 0) : RatNum :=
  match a.num with
  | Int.ofNat (Nat.succ n) =>
    RatNum.mk (a.den : Int) (Nat.succ n) (Nat.zero_lt_succ n)
  | Int.negSucc n =>
    RatNum.mk (-(a.den : Int)) (Nat.succ n) (Nat.zero_lt_succ n)
  | Int.ofNat 0 => absurd (Eq.refl (Int.ofNat 0)) h

def ratnum_le (a b : RatNum) : Prop :=
  a.num * (b.den : Int) ≤ b.num * (a.den : Int)

def ratnum_lt (a b : RatNum) : Prop :=
  a.num * (b.den : Int) < b.num * (a.den : Int)

def ratnum_eq (a b : RatNum) : Prop :=
  a.num * (b.den : Int) = b.num * (a.den : Int)

def ratnum_abs (a : RatNum) : RatNum :=
  RatNum.mk (Int.natAbs a.num : Int) a.den a.den_pos

theorem ratnum_add_den_pos (a b : RatNum) : 0 < (ratnum_add a b).den :=
  Nat.mul_pos a.den_pos b.den_pos

theorem ratnum_mul_den_pos (a b : RatNum) : 0 < (ratnum_mul a b).den :=
  Nat.mul_pos a.den_pos b.den_pos

theorem ratnum_neg_den_pos (a : RatNum) : 0 < (ratnum_neg a).den :=
  a.den_pos

theorem ratnum_sub_den_pos (a b : RatNum) : 0 < (ratnum_sub a b).den :=
  ratnum_add_den_pos a (ratnum_neg b)

theorem ratnum_add_comm_eq (a b : RatNum) :
    ratnum_eq (ratnum_add a b) (ratnum_add b a) :=
  show (a.num * b.den + b.num * a.den) * (b.den * a.den) =
       (b.num * a.den + a.num * b.den) * (a.den * b.den) from
  let lhs_num : a.num * b.den + b.num * a.den = b.num * a.den + a.num * b.den :=
    Int.add_comm (a.num * b.den) (b.num * a.den)
  let rhs_den : b.den * a.den = a.den * b.den :=
    Nat.mul_comm b.den a.den
  let step1 : (a.num * b.den + b.num * a.den) * (b.den * a.den) =
              (b.num * a.den + a.num * b.den) * (b.den * a.den) :=
    congrArg (· * (b.den * a.den : Int)) lhs_num
  let step2 : (b.num * a.den + a.num * b.den) * (b.den * a.den) =
              (b.num * a.den + a.num * b.den) * (a.den * b.den) :=
    congrArg ((b.num * a.den + a.num * b.den) * ·)
      (congrArg Int.ofNat rhs_den)
  Eq.trans step1 step2

theorem ratnum_zero_add_eq (a : RatNum) : ratnum_eq (ratnum_add ratnum_zero a) a :=
  show (0 * a.den + a.num * 1) * a.den = a.num * (1 * a.den) from
  let lhs_simplify : (0 : Int) * a.den + a.num * 1 = a.num :=
    let s1 : (0 : Int) * (a.den : Int) = 0 := Int.zero_mul (a.den : Int)
    let s2 : a.num * 1 = a.num := Int.mul_one a.num
    let s3 : (0 : Int) + a.num = a.num := Int.zero_add a.num
    Eq.trans (congrArg₂ (· + ·) s1 s2) s3
  let rhs_simplify : a.num * (1 * a.den) = a.num * a.den :=
    congrArg (a.num * ·) (Int.one_mul (a.den : Int))
  Eq.trans (congrArg (· * a.den) lhs_simplify) (Eq.symm rhs_simplify)

theorem ratnum_add_zero_eq (a : RatNum) : ratnum_eq (ratnum_add a ratnum_zero) a :=
  let comm : ratnum_eq (ratnum_add a ratnum_zero) (ratnum_add ratnum_zero a) :=
    ratnum_add_comm_eq a ratnum_zero
  let zero_add : ratnum_eq (ratnum_add ratnum_zero a) a :=
    ratnum_zero_add_eq a
  show (a.num * 1 + 0 * a.den) * a.den = a.num * (a.den * 1) from
  let lhs : a.num * 1 + (0 : Int) * a.den = a.num :=
    let s1 : a.num * 1 = a.num := Int.mul_one a.num
    let s2 : (0 : Int) * a.den = 0 := Int.zero_mul a.den
    let s3 : a.num + 0 = a.num := Int.add_zero a.num
    Eq.trans (congrArg₂ (· + ·) s1 s2) s3
  let rhs : a.num * (a.den * 1 : Int) = a.num * a.den :=
    congrArg (a.num * ·) (Int.mul_one a.den)
  Eq.trans (congrArg (· * a.den) lhs) (Eq.symm rhs)

theorem ratnum_mul_comm_eq (a b : RatNum) :
    ratnum_eq (ratnum_mul a b) (ratnum_mul b a) :=
  show a.num * b.num * (b.den * a.den) = b.num * a.num * (a.den * b.den) from
  let num_comm : a.num * b.num = b.num * a.num := Int.mul_comm a.num b.num
  let den_comm : b.den * a.den = a.den * b.den := Nat.mul_comm b.den a.den
  congrArg₂ (· * ·) num_comm (congrArg Int.ofNat den_comm)

theorem ratnum_mul_one_eq (a : RatNum) : ratnum_eq (ratnum_mul a ratnum_one) a :=
  show a.num * 1 * (1 * a.den) = a.num * (a.den * 1) from
  let s1 : a.num * 1 = a.num := Int.mul_one a.num
  let s2 : (1 : Int) * a.den = a.den := Int.one_mul a.den
  let s3 : a.num * (a.den * 1 : Int) = a.num * a.den :=
    congrArg (a.num * ·) (Int.mul_one a.den)
  let lhs : a.num * 1 * (1 * a.den) = a.num * a.den :=
    Eq.trans (congrArg₂ (· * ·) s1 s2) (Int.mul_one a.num |>.symm |>.symm)
  Eq.trans lhs (Eq.symm s3)

theorem ratnum_one_mul_eq (a : RatNum) : ratnum_eq (ratnum_mul ratnum_one a) a :=
  let comm : ratnum_eq (ratnum_mul ratnum_one a) (ratnum_mul a ratnum_one) :=
    ratnum_mul_comm_eq ratnum_one a
  show 1 * a.num * (a.den * 1) = a.num * (1 * a.den) from
  let s1 : (1 : Int) * a.num = a.num := Int.one_mul a.num
  let s2 : a.den * 1 = a.den := Nat.mul_one a.den
  let s3 : (1 : Int) * a.den = a.den := Int.one_mul a.den
  let s4 : a.num * (1 * a.den : Int) = a.num * a.den :=
    congrArg (a.num * ·) s3
  Eq.trans (congrArg₂ (· * ·) s1 (congrArg Int.ofNat s2))
    (Eq.symm s4)

theorem ratnum_le_refl (a : RatNum) : ratnum_le a a :=
  le_refl (a.num * (a.den : Int))

theorem ratnum_le_trans (a b c : RatNum)
    (hab : ratnum_le a b) (hbc : ratnum_le b c) : ratnum_le a c :=
  show a.num * c.den ≤ c.num * a.den from
  let h1 : a.num * b.den ≤ b.num * a.den := hab
  let h2 : b.num * c.den ≤ c.num * b.den := hbc
  let bden_pos : (0 : Int) < b.den := Int.ofNat_lt.mpr b.den_pos
  Int.le_of_mul_le_mul_right
    (show a.num * c.den * b.den ≤ c.num * a.den * b.den from
      let lhs_expand : a.num * c.den * b.den = a.num * b.den * c.den :=
        Int.mul_right_comm a.num c.den b.den
      let rhs_expand : c.num * a.den * b.den = c.num * b.den * a.den :=
        Int.mul_right_comm c.num a.den b.den
      Eq.subst lhs_expand.symm
        (Eq.subst rhs_expand.symm
          (Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
            (Int.le_trans
              (Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1
                (Int.ofNat_nonneg c.den))
              (Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2
                (Int.ofNat_nonneg a.den)))
            (le_refl _))))
    bden_pos

theorem ratnum_eq_refl (a : RatNum) : ratnum_eq a a :=
  Eq.refl _

theorem ratnum_eq_symm (a b : RatNum) (h : ratnum_eq a b) : ratnum_eq b a :=
  Eq.symm h

theorem ratnum_eq_trans (a b c : RatNum)
    (hab : ratnum_eq a b) (hbc : ratnum_eq b c) : ratnum_eq a c :=
  show a.num * c.den = c.num * a.den from
  let h1 : a.num * b.den = b.num * a.den := hab
  let h2 : b.num * c.den = c.num * b.den := hbc
  let bden_pos : (0 : Int) < b.den := Int.ofNat_lt.mpr b.den_pos
  Int.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_right bden_pos
    (show a.num * c.den * b.den = c.num * a.den * b.den from
      let lhs : a.num * c.den * b.den = a.num * b.den * c.den :=
        Int.mul_right_comm a.num c.den b.den
      let rhs : c.num * a.den * b.den = c.num * b.den * a.den :=
        Int.mul_right_comm c.num a.den b.den
      Eq.trans lhs
        (Eq.trans
          (congrArg (· * c.den) h1)
          (Eq.trans
            (congrArg (b.num * ·) (Int.mul_comm c.den a.den))
            (Eq.trans
              (Int.mul_assoc b.num a.den c.den).symm
              (Eq.trans
                (congrArg (· * c.den) h2.symm)
                (Eq.trans
                  (Int.mul_assoc c.num b.den c.den)
                  (Eq.trans
                    (congrArg (c.num * ·) (Int.mul_comm b.den c.den))
                    (Eq.trans
                      (Int.mul_assoc c.num c.den b.den).symm
                      (Eq.trans
                        (congrArg (· * b.den) (Int.mul_comm c.num c.den))
                        (Eq.symm rhs)))))))))

theorem ratnum_neg_add_eq (a : RatNum) :
    ratnum_eq (ratnum_add a (ratnum_neg a)) ratnum_zero :=
  show a.num * a.den + (-a.num) * a.den = 0 * (a.den * a.den) from
  let s1 : a.num * a.den + (-a.num) * a.den =
           (a.num + (-a.num)) * a.den :=
    (Int.add_mul a.num (-a.num) a.den).symm
  let s2 : a.num + (-a.num) = 0 := Int.add_right_neg a.num
  let s3 : (0 : Int) * a.den = 0 := Int.zero_mul a.den
  let s4 : (0 : Int) * (a.den * a.den) = 0 := Int.zero_mul (a.den * a.den)
  Eq.trans (Eq.trans s1 (congrArg (· * a.den) s2)) (Eq.trans s3 s4.symm)

theorem ratnum_add_neg_eq (a : RatNum) :
    ratnum_eq (ratnum_add (ratnum_neg a) a) ratnum_zero :=
  let comm : ratnum_eq (ratnum_add (ratnum_neg a) a) (ratnum_add a (ratnum_neg a)) :=
    ratnum_add_comm_eq (ratnum_neg a) a
  ratnum_eq_trans _ _ _ comm (ratnum_neg_add_eq a)

theorem ratnum_abs_nonneg (a : RatNum) : ratnum_le ratnum_zero (ratnum_abs a) :=
  show (0 : Int) * a.den ≤ Int.natAbs a.num * 1 from
  let s1 : (0 : Int) * a.den = 0 := Int.zero_mul a.den
  let s2 : Int.natAbs a.num * 1 = Int.natAbs a.num :=
    Int.mul_one (Int.natAbs a.num : Int)
  Eq.subst s1.symm (Eq.subst s2.symm (Int.ofNat_nonneg (Int.natAbs a.num)))

structure RatClipRange where

  clip_max : RatNum

  max_finite : True

theorem cliprange_min_le_max (r : RatClipRange) : ratnum_le r.clip_min r.clip_max :=

  fun h =>
    let lt_irrefl : ¬ ratnum_lt r.clip_min r.clip_max :=
      fun hlt => lt_irrefl (r.clip_min.num * r.clip_max.den) (h ▸ hlt)
    lt_irrefl r.min_lt_max

def checkedMul_spec (a b : Nat) : RSFResult Nat :=
  let product := a * b
  if a ≠ 0 ∧ product / a ≠ b then rsf_err RSFError.Overflow
  else rsf_ok product

theorem checkedMul_zero_left (b : Nat) : checkedMul_spec 0 b = rsf_ok 0 :=
  show (if 0 ≠ 0 ∧ 0 * b / 0 ≠ b then rsf_err RSFError.Overflow else rsf_ok (0 * b)) = rsf_ok 0 from
  let h : ¬ (0 ≠ 0 ∧ 0 * b / 0 ≠ b) :=
    fun hc => absurd hc.1 (fun hn => hn (Eq.refl 0))
  let step : (if 0 ≠ 0 ∧ 0 * b / 0 ≠ b then rsf_err RSFError.Overflow else rsf_ok (0 * b)) =
             rsf_ok (0 * b) :=
    if_neg h
  Eq.trans step (congrArg rsf_ok (Nat.zero_mul b))

theorem checkedMul_zero_right (a : Nat) : checkedMul_spec a 0 = rsf_ok 0 :=
  show (if a ≠ 0 ∧ a * 0 / a ≠ 0 then rsf_err RSFError.Overflow else rsf_ok (a * 0)) = rsf_ok 0 from
  Nat.casesOn a
    (show (if 0 ≠ 0 ∧ 0 * 0 / 0 ≠ 0 then rsf_err RSFError.Overflow else rsf_ok (0 * 0)) = rsf_ok 0 from
      let h : ¬ (0 ≠ 0 ∧ 0 * 0 / 0 ≠ 0) := fun hc => absurd hc.1 (fun hn => hn (Eq.refl 0))
      Eq.trans (if_neg h) (congrArg rsf_ok (Nat.zero_mul 0)))
    (fun n =>
      let zero_cond : n.succ * 0 = 0 := Nat.mul_zero n.succ
      let div_cond : n.succ * 0 / n.succ = 0 :=
        Eq.trans (congrArg (· / n.succ) zero_cond) (Nat.zero_div n.succ)
      let eq_zero : n.succ * 0 / n.succ = 0 := div_cond
      let not_ne : ¬ (n.succ * 0 / n.succ ≠ 0) :=
        fun hn => absurd eq_zero hn
      let not_cond : ¬ (n.succ ≠ 0 ∧ n.succ * 0 / n.succ ≠ 0) :=
        fun hc => not_ne hc.2
      Eq.trans (if_neg not_cond) (congrArg rsf_ok zero_cond))

def checkedMulU64_spec (a b : Nat) : RSFResult Nat :=
  checkedMul_spec a b

def checkedAddU64_spec (a b : Nat) : RSFResult Nat :=
  let sum := a + b
  if sum < a then rsf_err RSFError.Overflow
  else rsf_ok sum

theorem checkedAddU64_zero_left (b : Nat) : checkedAddU64_spec 0 b = rsf_ok b :=
  show (if 0 + b < 0 then rsf_err RSFError.Overflow else rsf_ok (0 + b)) = rsf_ok b from
  let no_overflow : ¬ (0 + b < 0) := Nat.not_lt_zero (0 + b)
  Eq.trans (if_neg no_overflow) (congrArg rsf_ok (Nat.zero_add b))

theorem checkedAddU64_zero_right (a : Nat) : checkedAddU64_spec a 0 = rsf_ok a :=
  show (if a + 0 < a then rsf_err RSFError.Overflow else rsf_ok (a + 0)) = rsf_ok a from
  let no_overflow : ¬ (a + 0 < a) :=
    fun h => lt_irrefl a (Eq.subst (Nat.add_zero a) h)
  Eq.trans (if_neg no_overflow) (congrArg rsf_ok (Nat.add_zero a))

theorem checkedAddU64_comm_ok (a b : Nat)
    (ha : checkedAddU64_spec a b = rsf_ok (a + b)) :
    checkedAddU64_spec b a = rsf_ok (b + a) :=
  show (if b + a < b then rsf_err RSFError.Overflow else rsf_ok (b + a)) = rsf_ok (b + a) from
  let no_overflow : ¬ (b + a < b) := fun h => lt_irrefl b (Nat.lt_of_add_lt_add_left h)
  if_neg no_overflow

structure TensorShape where
  ndim : Nat
  dims : Fin ndim → Nat

def tensor_shape_2d (rows cols : Nat) : TensorShape :=
  TensorShape.mk 2 (fun i => match i with
    | ⟨0, _⟩ => rows
    | ⟨1, _⟩ => cols
    | ⟨Nat.succ (Nat.succ _), h⟩ => absurd h (by omega))

theorem tensor_shape_2d_ndim (rows cols : Nat) :
    (tensor_shape_2d rows cols).ndim = 2 :=
  Eq.refl _

theorem tensor_shape_2d_dim0 (rows cols : Nat) :
    (tensor_shape_2d rows cols).dims ⟨0, Nat.zero_lt_succ 1⟩ = rows :=
  Eq.refl _

theorem tensor_shape_2d_dim1 (rows cols : Nat) :
    (tensor_shape_2d rows cols).dims ⟨1, Nat.lt_succ_self 1⟩ = cols :=
  Eq.refl _

def tensorShape_is2D (s : TensorShape) : Prop := s.ndim = 2

theorem tensor_shape_2d_is2D (rows cols : Nat) :
    tensorShape_is2D (tensor_shape_2d rows cols) :=
  Eq.refl _

def tensorShape_numel (s : TensorShape) : Nat :=
  match s.ndim with
  | 0 => 1
  | Nat.succ n =>
    let rec go : ∀ (k : Nat) (acc : Nat), k ≤ s.ndim → Nat
      | 0, acc, _ => acc
      | Nat.succ m, acc, hk =>
          go m (acc * s.dims ⟨m, hk⟩) (Nat.le_of_succ_le hk)
    go s.ndim 1 (Nat.le_refl s.ndim)

theorem tensorShape_numel_2d (rows cols : Nat) :
    tensorShape_numel (tensor_shape_2d rows cols) = rows * cols :=
  Eq.refl _

structure Tensor where
  shape : TensorShape
  data  : List RatNum
  shape_is_2d : tensorShape_is2D shape
  data_len_ok : data.length = tensorShape_numel shape

def tensor_data_length_eq_numel (t : Tensor) :
    t.data.length = tensorShape_numel t.shape :=
  t.data_len_ok

def tensor_rows (t : Tensor) : Nat :=
  t.shape.dims ⟨0, Eq.subst t.shape_is_2d.symm (Nat.zero_lt_succ 1)⟩

def tensor_cols (t : Tensor) : Nat :=
  t.shape.dims ⟨1, Eq.subst t.shape_is_2d.symm (Nat.lt_succ_self 1)⟩

theorem tensor_data_length (t : Tensor) :
    t.data.length = tensor_rows t * tensor_cols t :=
  Eq.trans t.data_len_ok (tensorShape_numel_2d (tensor_rows t) (tensor_cols t))

def make_tensor_2d (rows cols : Nat) (data : List RatNum)
    (hlen : data.length = rows * cols) : Tensor :=
  Tensor.mk
    (tensor_shape_2d rows cols)
    data
    (tensor_shape_2d_is2D rows cols)
    (Eq.trans hlen (tensorShape_numel_2d rows cols).symm)

theorem make_tensor_2d_rows (rows cols : Nat) (data : List RatNum)
    (hlen : data.length = rows * cols) :
    tensor_rows (make_tensor_2d rows cols data hlen) = rows :=
  Eq.refl _

theorem make_tensor_2d_cols (rows cols : Nat) (data : List RatNum)
    (hlen : data.length = rows * cols) :
    tensor_cols (make_tensor_2d rows cols data hlen) = cols :=
  Eq.refl _

theorem make_tensor_2d_data_length (rows cols : Nat) (data : List RatNum)
    (hlen : data.length = rows * cols) :
    (make_tensor_2d rows cols data hlen).data.length = rows * cols :=
  hlen

def tensor_zero_2d (rows cols : Nat) : Tensor :=
  let n := rows * cols
  let data := List.replicate n ratnum_zero
  let hlen : data.length = rows * cols :=
    Eq.trans (List.length_replicate n ratnum_zero) (Eq.refl n)
  make_tensor_2d rows cols data hlen

theorem tensor_zero_2d_rows (rows cols : Nat) :
    tensor_rows (tensor_zero_2d rows cols) = rows :=
  Eq.refl _

theorem tensor_zero_2d_cols (rows cols : Nat) :
    tensor_cols (tensor_zero_2d rows cols) = cols :=
  Eq.refl _

theorem tensor_zero_2d_data_length (rows cols : Nat) :
    (tensor_zero_2d rows cols).data.length = rows * cols :=
  List.length_replicate (rows * cols) ratnum_zero

def tensor_get_elem (t : Tensor) (row col : Nat)
    (hrow : row < tensor_rows t) (hcol : col < tensor_cols t) : RatNum :=
  let idx := row * tensor_cols t + col
  let h : idx < t.data.length :=
    Eq.subst (tensor_data_length t).symm
      (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le
        (Nat.add_lt_add_left hcol (row * tensor_cols t))
        (Nat.mul_le_mul_right (tensor_cols t)
          (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hrow)))
  List.get t.data ⟨idx, h⟩

theorem tensor_get_elem_idx_lt (t : Tensor) (row col : Nat)
    (hrow : row < tensor_rows t) (hcol : col < tensor_cols t) :
    row * tensor_cols t + col < t.data.length :=
  Eq.subst (tensor_data_length t).symm
    (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le
      (Nat.add_lt_add_left hcol (row * tensor_cols t))
      (Nat.mul_le_mul_right (tensor_cols t)
        (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hrow)))

def tensorsSameShape (a b : Tensor) : Prop :=
  tensor_rows a = tensor_rows b ∧ tensor_cols a = tensor_cols b

theorem tensorsSameShape_refl (t : Tensor) : tensorsSameShape t t :=
  And.intro (Eq.refl _) (Eq.refl _)

theorem tensorsSameShape_symm (a b : Tensor)
    (h : tensorsSameShape a b) : tensorsSameShape b a :=
  And.intro h.2.symm h.1.symm

theorem tensorsSameShape_trans (a b c : Tensor)
    (hab : tensorsSameShape a b) (hbc : tensorsSameShape b c) :
    tensorsSameShape a c :=
  And.intro (Eq.trans hab.1 hbc.1) (Eq.trans hab.2 hbc.2)

theorem tensorsSameShape_rows_eq (a b : Tensor) (h : tensorsSameShape a b) :
    tensor_rows a = tensor_rows b := h.1

theorem tensorsSameShape_cols_eq (a b : Tensor) (h : tensorsSameShape a b) :
    tensor_cols a = tensor_cols b := h.2

theorem tensorsSameShape_data_length_eq (a b : Tensor) (h : tensorsSameShape a b) :
    a.data.length = b.data.length :=
  Eq.trans (tensor_data_length a)
    (Eq.trans (congrArg₂ (· * ·) h.1 h.2)
      (tensor_data_length b).symm)

def tensorHasShape (t : Tensor) (rows cols : Nat) : Prop :=
  tensor_rows t = rows ∧ tensor_cols t = cols

theorem tensorHasShape_iff (t : Tensor) (rows cols : Nat) :
    tensorHasShape t rows cols ↔
    (tensor_rows t = rows ∧ tensor_cols t = cols) :=
  Iff.intro id id

theorem tensorHasShape_refl_rows (t : Tensor) (cols : Nat)
    (h : tensor_cols t = cols) : tensorHasShape t (tensor_rows t) cols :=
  And.intro (Eq.refl _) h

theorem tensorHasShape_refl_cols (t : Tensor) (rows : Nat)
    (h : tensor_rows t = rows) : tensorHasShape t rows (tensor_cols t) :=
  And.intro h (Eq.refl _)

theorem tensorHasShape_same_as_sameShape (a b : Tensor) :
    tensorsSameShape a b ↔ tensorHasShape b (tensor_rows a) (tensor_cols a) :=
  Iff.intro
    (fun h => And.intro h.1.symm h.2.symm)
    (fun h => And.intro h.1.symm h.2.symm)

def validateTensor2D_prop (t : Tensor) : Prop :=
  tensorShape_is2D t.shape ∧
  t.data.length = tensor_rows t * tensor_cols t

theorem validateTensor2D_holds (t : Tensor) : validateTensor2D_prop t :=
  And.intro t.shape_is_2d (tensor_data_length t)

def validateTensor2DShape_prop (t : Tensor) (rows cols : Nat) : Prop :=
  tensorHasShape t rows cols ∧ t.data.length = rows * cols

theorem validateTensor2DShape_holds (t : Tensor) (rows cols : Nat)
    (h : tensorHasShape t rows cols) : validateTensor2DShape_prop t rows cols :=
  And.intro h
    (Eq.trans (tensor_data_length t)
      (congrArg₂ (· * ·) h.1 h.2))

theorem validateTensor2DShape_rows_eq (t : Tensor) (rows cols : Nat)
    (h : validateTensor2DShape_prop t rows cols) :
    tensor_rows t = rows := h.1.1

theorem validateTensor2DShape_cols_eq (t : Tensor) (rows cols : Nat)
    (h : validateTensor2DShape_prop t rows cols) :
    tensor_cols t = cols := h.1.2

def tensor_all_zero (t : Tensor) : Prop :=
  ∀ i : Fin t.data.length, ratnum_eq (List.get t.data i) ratnum_zero

theorem tensor_zero_2d_all_zero (rows cols : Nat) :
    tensor_all_zero (tensor_zero_2d rows cols) :=
  fun i =>
    let hval : List.get (List.replicate (rows * cols) ratnum_zero) i = ratnum_zero :=
      List.get_replicate (rows * cols) ratnum_zero i
    Eq.subst hval (ratnum_eq_refl ratnum_zero)

def tensor_all_finite (t : Tensor) : Prop := True

theorem tensor_zero_2d_all_finite (rows cols : Nat) :
    tensor_all_finite (tensor_zero_2d rows cols) :=
  True.intro

structure LayerWeightInvariant (dim : Nat) (sw tw sb tb : Tensor) : Prop where
  sw_rows : tensor_rows sw = dim
  sw_cols : tensor_cols sw = dim
  tw_rows : tensor_rows tw = dim
  tw_cols : tensor_cols tw = dim
  sb_rows : tensor_rows sb = 1
  sb_cols : tensor_cols sb = dim
  tb_rows : tensor_rows tb = 1
  tb_cols : tensor_cols tb = dim
  sw_finite : tensor_all_finite sw
  tw_finite : tensor_all_finite tw
  sb_finite : tensor_all_finite sb
  tb_finite : tensor_all_finite tb

theorem layer_weight_invariant_sw_numel (dim : Nat)
    (sw tw sb tb : Tensor) (h : LayerWeightInvariant dim sw tw sb tb) :
    sw.data.length = dim * dim :=
  Eq.trans (tensor_data_length sw)
    (congrArg₂ (· * ·) h.sw_rows h.sw_cols)

theorem layer_weight_invariant_tw_numel (dim : Nat)
    (sw tw sb tb : Tensor) (h : LayerWeightInvariant dim sw tw sb tb) :
    tw.data.length = dim * dim :=
  Eq.trans (tensor_data_length tw)
    (congrArg₂ (· * ·) h.tw_rows h.tw_cols)

theorem layer_weight_invariant_sb_numel (dim : Nat)
    (sw tw sb tb : Tensor) (h : LayerWeightInvariant dim sw tw sb tb) :
    sb.data.length = 1 * dim :=
  Eq.trans (tensor_data_length sb)
    (congrArg₂ (· * ·) h.sb_rows h.sb_cols)

theorem layer_weight_invariant_tb_numel (dim : Nat)
    (sw tw sb tb : Tensor) (h : LayerWeightInvariant dim sw tw sb tb) :
    tb.data.length = 1 * dim :=
  Eq.trans (tensor_data_length tb)
    (congrArg₂ (· * ·) h.tb_rows h.tb_cols)

theorem layer_weight_invariant_sb_numel' (dim : Nat)
    (sw tw sb tb : Tensor) (h : LayerWeightInvariant dim sw tw sb tb) :
    sb.data.length = dim :=
  Eq.trans (layer_weight_invariant_sb_numel dim sw tw sb tb h) (Nat.one_mul dim)

theorem layer_weight_invariant_tb_numel' (dim : Nat)
    (sw tw sb tb : Tensor) (h : LayerWeightInvariant dim sw tw sb tb) :
    tb.data.length = dim :=
  Eq.trans (layer_weight_invariant_tb_numel dim sw tw sb tb h) (Nat.one_mul dim)

      (And.intro

        (Eq.subst htb (show (none.map (fun g : Tensor => tensorHasShape g 1 lc.dim)).getD True = True from Eq.refl _))))

def ratnum_clip (v lo hi : RatNum) : RatNum :=
  if ratnum_lt v lo then lo
  else if ratnum_lt hi v then hi
  else v

theorem ratnum_clip_lo_le_result (v lo hi : RatNum) :
    ratnum_le lo (ratnum_clip v lo hi) :=
  if h1 : ratnum_lt v lo then
    Eq.subst (if_pos h1 : ratnum_clip v lo hi = lo).symm (ratnum_le_refl lo)
  else
    let clip_ne_lo : ratnum_clip v lo hi = (if ratnum_lt hi v then hi else v) :=
      if_neg h1
    if h2 : ratnum_lt hi v then
      Eq.subst (Eq.trans clip_ne_lo (if_pos h2) : ratnum_clip v lo hi = hi).symm
        (ratnum_le_trans lo v hi (le_of_not_lt h1) (le_of_lt h2))
    else
      Eq.subst (Eq.trans clip_ne_lo (if_neg h2) : ratnum_clip v lo hi = v).symm
        (le_of_not_lt h1)

theorem ratnum_clip_result_le_hi (v lo hi : RatNum) :
    ratnum_le (ratnum_clip v lo hi) hi :=
  if h1 : ratnum_lt v lo then
    Eq.subst (if_pos h1 : ratnum_clip v lo hi = lo).symm
      (ratnum_le_trans lo v hi (le_of_lt h1) (ratnum_le_refl hi))
  else
    let clip_ne_lo : ratnum_clip v lo hi = (if ratnum_lt hi v then hi else v) :=
      if_neg h1
    if h2 : ratnum_lt hi v then
      Eq.subst (Eq.trans clip_ne_lo (if_pos h2) : ratnum_clip v lo hi = hi).symm
        (ratnum_le_refl hi)
    else
      Eq.subst (Eq.trans clip_ne_lo (if_neg h2) : ratnum_clip v lo hi = v).symm
        (le_of_not_lt h2)

theorem ratnum_clip_within_bounds (v lo hi : RatNum) :
    ratnum_le lo (ratnum_clip v lo hi) ∧ ratnum_le (ratnum_clip v lo hi) hi :=
  And.intro (ratnum_clip_lo_le_result v lo hi) (ratnum_clip_result_le_hi v lo hi)

theorem ratnum_clip_idempotent (v lo hi : RatNum)
    (hlo : ratnum_le lo v) (hhi : ratnum_le v hi) :
    ratnum_clip v lo hi = v :=
  if h1 : ratnum_lt v lo then
    absurd h1 (not_lt.mpr hlo)
  else
    let step : ratnum_clip v lo hi = (if ratnum_lt hi v then hi else v) := if_neg h1
    if h2 : ratnum_lt hi v then
      absurd h2 (not_lt.mpr hhi)
    else
      Eq.trans step (if_neg h2)

def ratnum_exp_approx (v : RatNum) : RatNum :=
  let clipped := ratnum_clip v
    (RatNum.mk (-20) 1 (Nat.zero_lt_succ 0))
    (RatNum.mk 20 1 (Nat.zero_lt_succ 0))
  let numer_scaled : Int := clipped.num * 1000
  let denom_scaled : Nat := clipped.den
  let exp_approx_numer : Int := numer_scaled + clipped.den * 1000
  RatNum.mk exp_approx_numer (denom_scaled * 1000)
    (Nat.mul_pos clipped.den_pos (Nat.zero_lt_succ 999))

theorem ratnum_exp_approx_den_pos (v : RatNum) :
    0 < (ratnum_exp_approx v).den :=
  Nat.mul_pos
    (ratnum_clip v _ _).den_pos
    (Nat.zero_lt_succ 999)

def compute_translation_row_spec
    (t_weight : Tensor) (t_bias : Tensor) (dim : Nat)
    (input_row : List RatNum)
    (hw : t_weight.data.length = dim * dim)
    (hb : t_bias.data.length = dim)
    (hi : input_row.length = dim) : List RatNum :=
  List.map (fun d =>
    let hd : d < dim := d.isLt
    let bias_val : RatNum :=
      List.get t_bias.data ⟨d, Eq.subst hb.symm hd⟩
    let row_start : Nat := d * dim
    let row_sum : RatNum :=
      List.foldl (fun acc j_fin =>
        let j : Nat := j_fin
        let hj : j < dim := j_fin.isLt
        let w_idx : Nat := row_start + j
        let hw_idx : w_idx < t_weight.data.length :=
          Eq.subst hw.symm (Nat.add_lt_add_left hj (d * dim))
        let x_j : RatNum :=
          List.get input_row ⟨j, Eq.subst hi.symm hj⟩
        let w_val : RatNum :=
          List.get t_weight.data ⟨w_idx, hw_idx⟩
        ratnum_add acc (ratnum_mul w_val x_j))
      ratnum_zero
      (List.finRange dim)
    ratnum_add bias_val row_sum)
  (List.finRange dim)

theorem compute_translation_row_spec_length
    (t_weight : Tensor) (t_bias : Tensor) (dim : Nat)
    (input_row : List RatNum)
    (hw : t_weight.data.length = dim * dim)
    (hb : t_bias.data.length = dim)
    (hi : input_row.length = dim) :
    (compute_translation_row_spec t_weight t_bias dim input_row hw hb hi).length = dim :=
  Eq.trans (List.length_map _ (List.finRange dim)) (List.length_finRange dim)

def compute_scale_row_spec
    (s_weight : Tensor) (s_bias : Tensor) (dim : Nat)
    (clip_range : RatClipRange)
    (input_row : List RatNum)
    (hw : s_weight.data.length = dim * dim)
    (hb : s_bias.data.length = dim)
    (hi : input_row.length = dim) : List RatNum :=
  List.map (fun d =>
    let hd : d < dim := d.isLt
    let bias_val : RatNum :=
      List.get s_bias.data ⟨d, Eq.subst hb.symm hd⟩
    let row_start : Nat := d * dim
    let pre_sum : RatNum :=
      List.foldl (fun acc j_fin =>
        let j : Nat := j_fin
        let hj : j < dim := j_fin.isLt
        let w_idx : Nat := row_start + j
        let hw_idx : w_idx < s_weight.data.length :=
          Eq.subst hw.symm (Nat.add_lt_add_left hj (d * dim))
        let x_j : RatNum :=
          List.get input_row ⟨j, Eq.subst hi.symm hj⟩
        let w_val : RatNum :=
          List.get s_weight.data ⟨w_idx, hw_idx⟩
        ratnum_add acc (ratnum_mul w_val x_j))
      bias_val
      (List.finRange dim)
    let clipped : RatNum := ratnum_clip pre_sum clip_range.clip_min clip_range.clip_max
    ratnum_exp_approx clipped)
  (List.finRange dim)

theorem compute_scale_row_spec_length
    (s_weight : Tensor) (s_bias : Tensor) (dim : Nat)
    (cr : RatClipRange) (input_row : List RatNum)
    (hw : s_weight.data.length = dim * dim)
    (hb : s_bias.data.length = dim)
    (hi : input_row.length = dim) :
    (compute_scale_row_spec s_weight s_bias dim cr input_row hw hb hi).length = dim :=
  Eq.trans (List.length_map _ (List.finRange dim)) (List.length_finRange dim)

theorem compute_scale_row_all_positive
    (s_weight : Tensor) (s_bias : Tensor) (dim : Nat)
    (cr : RatClipRange) (input_row : List RatNum)
    (hw : s_weight.data.length = dim * dim)
    (hb : s_bias.data.length = dim)
    (hi : input_row.length = dim) :
    ∀ i : Fin (compute_scale_row_spec s_weight s_bias dim cr input_row hw hb hi).length,
      0 < (List.get (compute_scale_row_spec s_weight s_bias dim cr input_row hw hb hi) i).den :=
  fun i =>
    let elem := List.get (compute_scale_row_spec s_weight s_bias dim cr input_row hw hb hi) i
    ratnum_exp_approx_den_pos _

def forward_step_row_spec
    (lc : LayerCore) (x1_row x2_row : List RatNum)
    (h1 : x1_row.length = lc.dim) (h2 : x2_row.length = lc.dim) :
    List RatNum × List RatNum :=
  let scale := compute_scale_row_spec
    lc.s_weight lc.s_bias lc.dim lc.clip_range x2_row
    (layercore_sw_numel lc) (layercore_sb_numel lc) h2
  let scaled_x1 := List.zipWith ratnum_mul x1_row scale
  let trans := compute_translation_row_spec
    lc.t_weight lc.t_bias lc.dim scaled_x1
    (layercore_tw_numel lc) (layercore_tb_numel lc)
    (Eq.trans (List.length_zipWith _ x1_row scale) (Nat.min_self lc.dim))
  let new_x2 := List.zipWith ratnum_add x2_row trans
  (scaled_x1, new_x2)

theorem forward_step_row_spec_x1_length
    (lc : LayerCore) (x1_row x2_row : List RatNum)
    (h1 : x1_row.length = lc.dim) (h2 : x2_row.length = lc.dim) :
    (forward_step_row_spec lc x1_row x2_row h1 h2).1.length = lc.dim :=
  let scale := compute_scale_row_spec
    lc.s_weight lc.s_bias lc.dim lc.clip_range x2_row
    (layercore_sw_numel lc) (layercore_sb_numel lc) h2
  let hscale : scale.length = lc.dim :=
    compute_scale_row_spec_length _ _ _ _ _ _ _ h2
  Eq.trans (List.length_zipWith _ x1_row scale)
    (Eq.trans (congrArg₂ Nat.min h1 hscale) (Nat.min_self lc.dim))

theorem forward_step_row_spec_x2_length
    (lc : LayerCore) (x1_row x2_row : List RatNum)
    (h1 : x1_row.length = lc.dim) (h2 : x2_row.length = lc.dim) :
    (forward_step_row_spec lc x1_row x2_row h1 h2).2.length = lc.dim :=
  let scale := compute_scale_row_spec
    lc.s_weight lc.s_bias lc.dim lc.clip_range x2_row
    (layercore_sw_numel lc) (layercore_sb_numel lc) h2
  let hscale : scale.length = lc.dim :=
    compute_scale_row_spec_length _ _ _ _ _ _ _ h2
  let scaled_x1 := List.zipWith ratnum_mul x1_row scale
  let scaled_x1_len : scaled_x1.length = lc.dim :=
    Eq.trans (List.length_zipWith _ x1_row scale)
      (Eq.trans (congrArg₂ Nat.min h1 hscale) (Nat.min_self lc.dim))
  let trans := compute_translation_row_spec
    lc.t_weight lc.t_bias lc.dim scaled_x1
    (layercore_tw_numel lc) (layercore_tb_numel lc) scaled_x1_len
  let htrans : trans.length = lc.dim :=
    compute_translation_row_spec_length _ _ _ _ _ _ scaled_x1_len
  Eq.trans (List.length_zipWith _ x2_row trans)
    (Eq.trans (congrArg₂ Nat.min h2 htrans) (Nat.min_self lc.dim))

def inverse_step_row_spec
    (lc : LayerCore) (y1_row y2_row : List RatNum)
    (h1 : y1_row.length = lc.dim) (h2 : y2_row.length = lc.dim) :
    List RatNum × List RatNum :=
  let trans := compute_translation_row_spec
    lc.t_weight lc.t_bias lc.dim y1_row
    (layercore_tw_numel lc) (layercore_tb_numel lc) h1
  let htrans : trans.length = lc.dim :=
    compute_translation_row_spec_length _ _ _ _ _ _ h1
  let new_y2 := List.zipWith ratnum_sub y2_row trans
  let new_y2_len : new_y2.length = lc.dim :=
    Eq.trans (List.length_zipWith _ y2_row trans)
      (Eq.trans (congrArg₂ Nat.min h2 htrans) (Nat.min_self lc.dim))
  let scale := compute_scale_row_spec
    lc.s_weight lc.s_bias lc.dim lc.clip_range new_y2
    (layercore_sw_numel lc) (layercore_sb_numel lc) new_y2_len
  let hscale : scale.length = lc.dim :=
    compute_scale_row_spec_length _ _ _ _ _ _ _ new_y2_len
  let inv_scale := List.map (fun sr =>
    ratnum_inv sr (ratnum_den_ne_zero sr)) scale
  let new_y1 := List.zipWith ratnum_mul y1_row inv_scale
  (new_y1, new_y2)

theorem inverse_step_row_spec_y1_length
    (lc : LayerCore) (y1_row y2_row : List RatNum)
    (h1 : y1_row.length = lc.dim) (h2 : y2_row.length = lc.dim) :
    (inverse_step_row_spec lc y1_row y2_row h1 h2).1.length = lc.dim :=
  let trans := compute_translation_row_spec
    lc.t_weight lc.t_bias lc.dim y1_row
    (layercore_tw_numel lc) (layercore_tb_numel lc) h1
  let htrans : trans.length = lc.dim :=
    compute_translation_row_spec_length _ _ _ _ _ _ h1
  let new_y2 := List.zipWith ratnum_sub y2_row trans
  let new_y2_len : new_y2.length = lc.dim :=
    Eq.trans (List.length_zipWith _ y2_row trans)
      (Eq.trans (congrArg₂ Nat.min h2 htrans) (Nat.min_self lc.dim))
  let scale := compute_scale_row_spec
    lc.s_weight lc.s_bias lc.dim lc.clip_range new_y2
    (layercore_sw_numel lc) (layercore_sb_numel lc) new_y2_len
  let hscale : scale.length = lc.dim :=
    compute_scale_row_spec_length _ _ _ _ _ _ _ new_y2_len
  let inv_scale := List.map (fun sr => ratnum_inv sr (ratnum_den_ne_zero sr)) scale
  let hinv : inv_scale.length = lc.dim :=
    Eq.trans (List.length_map _ scale) hscale
  Eq.trans (List.length_zipWith _ y1_row inv_scale)
    (Eq.trans (congrArg₂ Nat.min h1 hinv) (Nat.min_self lc.dim))

theorem inverse_step_row_spec_y2_length
    (lc : LayerCore) (y1_row y2_row : List RatNum)
    (h1 : y1_row.length = lc.dim) (h2 : y2_row.length = lc.dim) :
    (inverse_step_row_spec lc y1_row y2_row h1 h2).2.length = lc.dim :=
  let trans := compute_translation_row_spec
    lc.t_weight lc.t_bias lc.dim y1_row
    (layercore_tw_numel lc) (layercore_tb_numel lc) h1
  let htrans : trans.length = lc.dim :=
    compute_translation_row_spec_length _ _ _ _ _ _ h1
  Eq.trans (List.length_zipWith _ y2_row trans)
    (Eq.trans (congrArg₂ Nat.min h2 htrans) (Nat.min_self lc.dim))

  | BatchForwardTrace.step x1i x2i x1o x2o rest =>
      let h1 : x1i.length = lc.dim := sorry
      let h2 : x2i.length = lc.dim := sorry

def trace_length (t : ExecutionTrace) : Nat := t.length

theorem trace_length_nil : trace_length [] = 0 := Eq.refl _

    trace_length (s :: t) = Nat.succ (trace_length t) :=
  List.length_cons s t

  | [] => 0
  | ExecutionStep.forwardLayer _ _ :: rest => Nat.succ (trace_forward_count rest)
  | _ :: rest => trace_forward_count rest

    trace_forward_count t ≤ trace_forward_count (s :: t) :=
  match s with
  | ExecutionStep.forwardLayer _ _ => Nat.le_succ _
  | ExecutionStep.inverseLayer _ _ => Nat.le_refl _
  | ExecutionStep.backwardLayer _ _ => Nat.le_refl _
  | ExecutionStep.zeroGrad _ => Nat.le_refl _
  | ExecutionStep.ensureGrad _ => Nat.le_refl _

theorem trace_forward_count_le_length (t : ExecutionTrace) :
    trace_forward_count t ≤ trace_length t :=
  List.recOn t
    (Nat.le_refl 0)
    (fun s rest ih =>
      match s with
      | ExecutionStep.forwardLayer _ _ =>
          Nat.succ_le_succ ih
      | _ =>
          Nat.le_trans ih (Nat.le_succ _))

  | [] => 0
  | ExecutionStep.inverseLayer _ _ :: rest => Nat.succ (trace_inverse_count rest)
  | _ :: rest => trace_inverse_count rest

      match s with
      | ExecutionStep.inverseLayer _ _ => Nat.succ_le_succ ih
      | _ => Nat.le_trans ih (Nat.le_succ _))

  | [] => 0

  | ExecutionStep.inverseLayer li _ :: rest =>

  | ExecutionStep.backwardLayer li _ :: rest =>

def ForwardInverseRoundtripProp (c : RSFCore) (x1 x2 : Tensor)
    (h1r : tensor_rows x1 = tensor_rows x2)
    (h1c : tensor_cols x1 = c.dim)
    (h2c : tensor_cols x2 = c.dim) : Prop :=
  let (y1, y2) := forward_all_layers_spec c x1 x2 h1r h1c h2c
  let hy1r : tensor_rows y1 = tensor_rows y2 := Eq.refl _
  let hy1c : tensor_cols y1 = c.dim :=
    forward_all_layers_spec_fst_cols c x1 x2 h1r h1c h2c
  let hy2c : tensor_cols y2 = c.dim :=
    forward_all_layers_spec_snd_cols c x1 x2 h1r h1c h2c
  let (z1, z2) := inverse_all_layers_spec c y1 y2 hy1r hy1c hy2c
  tensorsSameShape z1 x1 ∧ tensorsSameShape z2 x2

theorem forward_inverse_same_shape (c : RSFCore) (x1 x2 : Tensor)
    (h1r : tensor_rows x1 = tensor_rows x2)
    (h1c : tensor_cols x1 = c.dim)
    (h2c : tensor_cols x2 = c.dim) :
    let (y1, y2) := forward_all_layers_spec c x1 x2 h1r h1c h2c
    tensor_rows y1 = tensor_rows x1 ∧
    tensor_rows y2 = tensor_rows x2 :=
  And.intro (Eq.refl _) (Eq.refl _)

theorem inverse_after_forward_same_dim (c : RSFCore) (x1 x2 : Tensor)
    (h1r : tensor_rows x1 = tensor_rows x2)
    (h1c : tensor_cols x1 = c.dim)
    (h2c : tensor_cols x2 = c.dim) :
    let (y1, y2) := forward_all_layers_spec c x1 x2 h1r h1c h2c
    let hy1r : tensor_rows y1 = tensor_rows y2 := Eq.refl _
    let hy1c : tensor_cols y1 = c.dim :=
      forward_all_layers_spec_fst_cols c x1 x2 h1r h1c h2c
    let hy2c : tensor_cols y2 = c.dim :=
      forward_all_layers_spec_snd_cols c x1 x2 h1r h1c h2c
    let (z1, z2) := inverse_all_layers_spec c y1 y2 hy1r hy1c hy2c
    tensor_cols z1 = c.dim ∧ tensor_cols z2 = c.dim :=
  And.intro
    (inverse_all_layers_spec_fst_cols c _ _ (Eq.refl _)
      (forward_all_layers_spec_fst_cols c x1 x2 h1r h1c h2c)
      (forward_all_layers_spec_snd_cols c x1 x2 h1r h1c h2c))
    (inverse_all_layers_spec_snd_cols c _ _ (Eq.refl _)
      (forward_all_layers_spec_fst_cols c x1 x2 h1r h1c h2c)
      (forward_all_layers_spec_snd_cols c x1 x2 h1r h1c h2c))

def serialized_model_to_rsfcore (m : SerializedModel) : RSFCore :=
  let layers := m.layer_weights.map (fun w =>
    serialized_to_layer_core w m.clip_range m.grad_mean)
  let cfg := RSFConfig.mk
    m.clip_range.clip_min m.clip_range.clip_max m.clip_range.min_lt_max
    m.grad_mean MAX_DIM_DEFAULT max_dim_default_pos
    MAX_LAYERS_DEFAULT max_layers_default_pos
  let layers_len : layers.length = m.num_layers :=
    Eq.trans (List.length_map _ m.layer_weights) m.layers_len
  let all_dim_ok : ∀ lc ∈ layers, lc.dim = m.dim :=
    fun lc hmem =>
      let ⟨w, hw_mem, hw_eq⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hmem
      Eq.trans (Eq.subst hw_eq.symm (Eq.refl lc.dim))
        (m.all_dim_ok w hw_mem)
  let all_clip : ∀ lc1 lc2 ∈ layers,
      ratnum_eq lc1.clip_range.clip_min lc2.clip_range.clip_min ∧
      ratnum_eq lc1.clip_range.clip_max lc2.clip_range.clip_max :=
    fun lc1 _ lc2 _ =>
      And.intro (ratnum_eq_refl _) (ratnum_eq_refl _)
  let all_gm : ∀ lc1 lc2 ∈ layers, lc1.grad_mean = lc2.grad_mean :=
    fun lc1 hm1 lc2 hm2 =>
      let ⟨w1, _, hw1⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hm1
      let ⟨w2, _, hw2⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hm2
      Eq.trans (Eq.subst hw1.symm (Eq.refl lc1.grad_mean))
        (Eq.subst hw2.symm (Eq.refl lc2.grad_mean))
  RSFCore.mk m.dim m.dim_pos m.num_layers m.num_layers_pos layers cfg
    false 0 0 false
    (ModelWeightInvariant.mk layers_len all_dim_ok all_clip all_gm)

theorem registry_ids_distinct_singleton (id : Nat) (e : RegistryEntry RSFCore) :

    let hj0 : j.val = 0 := Nat.lt_one_iff_eq_zero.mp j.isLt

theorem registry_ids_distinct_cons_fresh
    (entries : List (Nat × RegistryEntry RSFCore))
    (id : Nat) (e : RegistryEntry RSFCore)
    (hfresh : ∀ entry ∈ entries, entry.1 ≠ id)
    (hdist : registry_ids_distinct entries) :
    registry_ids_distinct ((id, e) :: entries) :=
  fun i j hij =>
    Fin.casesOn i
      (fun hi =>
        Fin.casesOn j
          (fun hj => absurd (Fin.eq_of_val_eq rfl) hij)
          (fun jval hjlt =>
            let hmem : entries.get ⟨jval, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hjlt⟩ ∈ entries :=
              List.get_mem entries jval (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hjlt)
            let hne : (entries.get ⟨jval, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hjlt⟩).1 ≠ id :=
              hfresh _ hmem
            fun heq => hne heq.symm))
      (fun ival hilt =>
        Fin.casesOn j
          (fun hj =>
            let hmem : entries.get ⟨ival, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hilt⟩ ∈ entries :=
              List.get_mem entries ival (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hilt)
            let hne : (entries.get ⟨ival, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hilt⟩).1 ≠ id :=
              hfresh _ hmem
            fun heq => hne heq)
          (fun jval hjlt =>
            hdist ⟨ival, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hilt⟩
              ⟨jval, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hjlt⟩
              (fun hfin => hij (Fin.ext (Fin.val_eq_val.mpr (Fin.succ_inj.mp hfin))))))

def version_distance (a b : RSFCore) : Nat :=
  if a.cpu_weight_version ≤ b.cpu_weight_version
  then b.cpu_weight_version - a.cpu_weight_version
  else a.cpu_weight_version - b.cpu_weight_version

theorem version_distance_self (c : RSFCore) : version_distance c c = 0 :=
  show (if c.cpu_weight_version ≤ c.cpu_weight_version
        then c.cpu_weight_version - c.cpu_weight_version
        else c.cpu_weight_version - c.cpu_weight_version) = 0 from
  let h : c.cpu_weight_version ≤ c.cpu_weight_version := Nat.le_refl _
  Eq.trans (if_pos h) (Nat.sub_self _)

theorem version_distance_symm (a b : RSFCore) :
    version_distance a b = version_distance b a :=
  show (if a.cpu_weight_version ≤ b.cpu_weight_version
        then b.cpu_weight_version - a.cpu_weight_version
        else a.cpu_weight_version - b.cpu_weight_version) =
       (if b.cpu_weight_version ≤ a.cpu_weight_version
        then a.cpu_weight_version - b.cpu_weight_version
        else b.cpu_weight_version - a.cpu_weight_version) from
  match Nat.le_or_lt a.cpu_weight_version b.cpu_weight_version with
  | Or.inl hab =>
      let lhs_val : version_distance a b = b.cpu_weight_version - a.cpu_weight_version :=
        if_pos hab
      match Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le hab with
      | Or.inl heq =>
          let rhs_val : version_distance b a =
              a.cpu_weight_version - b.cpu_weight_version :=
            if_pos (Nat.le_of_eq heq.symm)
          Eq.trans lhs_val (Eq.trans (congrArg (b.cpu_weight_version - ·) heq)
            (Eq.trans (Nat.sub_self _) (Eq.symm (congrArg (· - b.cpu_weight_version) heq.symm |>.trans (Nat.sub_self _))) ) |>.symm |>.symm)
      | Or.inr hlt =>
          let rhs_val : version_distance b a =
              b.cpu_weight_version - a.cpu_weight_version :=
            if_neg (Nat.not_le.mpr hlt)
          Eq.trans lhs_val rhs_val.symm
  | Or.inr hlt =>
      let lhs_val : version_distance a b = a.cpu_weight_version - b.cpu_weight_version :=
        if_neg (Nat.not_le.mpr hlt)
      let rhs_val : version_distance b a =
          a.cpu_weight_version - b.cpu_weight_version :=
        if_pos (Nat.le_of_lt hlt)
      Eq.trans lhs_val rhs_val.symm

theorem version_distance_triangle (a b c : RSFCore) :
    version_distance a c ≤ version_distance a b + version_distance b c :=
  match Nat.le_or_lt a.cpu_weight_version c.cpu_weight_version with
  | Or.inl hac =>
      let d_ac : version_distance a c = c.cpu_weight_version - a.cpu_weight_version :=
        if_pos hac
      Eq.subst d_ac.symm
        (Nat.sub_le_sum_diffs a.cpu_weight_version b.cpu_weight_version
          c.cpu_weight_version hac)
  | Or.inr hac =>
      let d_ac : version_distance a c = a.cpu_weight_version - c.cpu_weight_version :=
        if_neg (Nat.not_le.mpr hac)
      Eq.subst d_ac.symm
        (Nat.sub_le_sum_diffs c.cpu_weight_version b.cpu_weight_version
          a.cpu_weight_version (Nat.le_of_lt hac))
